wins: Completed initial network sweep and identified the management subnet (ep001_step04).
Captured service banners for target hosts, providing actionable context for later exploitation (ep001_step07).
fails: Failed to gain valid credentials for the web application after the third brute-force attempt (ep001_step12).
Privilege escalation attempts stalled due to inability to trigger a vulnerable service (ep001_step15).
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance was thorough, but credential acquisition and privilege escalation did not progress, leaving the attack chain incomplete.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Credential guessing against the web login repeatedly timed out or was locked after a few attempts.

skill_cards.if_condition: When a host responds with HTTP 200 and an exposed login form
skill_cards.then_action: Invoke Hydra with a curated credential list targeting the login endpoint

skill_cards.if_condition: When nmap shows hidden SMB shares on a Windows host
skill_cards.then_action: Run smbclient -L to enumerate share ACLs before attempting credential reuse

memory_ops.reason: SMB share enumeration consistently produced useful insight during initial service discovery.

next_experiments.title: Switch to passthrough proxy for web brute-force
next_experiments.description: Introduce Burp Suite intruder with slow-rate, randomized timing to avoid lockouts and capture CSRF tokens before retrying authentication.

next_experiments.title: Leverage SMB anonymous login after share enumeration
next_experiments.description: Use credentials harvested from HTTP brute-force attempts (if any) or null session to enumerate local users via rpcclient before pivoting to escalation.
